summary: This is a genuine, verified corrective fix for the real PR #562 AUDIT FAIL findings, not a self-report to trust blindly: I read the actual source (not just PROGRESS.md's claims) and confirmed Layer 1 (layer1-input-sanitization.ts) now cross-checks the production checkPromptInjection() gate as a floor, Layer 4 (layer4-output-filtering.ts) now delegates to pii-redaction.ts's new findPii()/redactPii() shared code path (closing the real GSTIN/PAN/IFSC/Aadhaar regression while keeping only the genuinely-additive SSN/US-phone categories), and defense-in-depth.ts's Layer 3 input- and output-side Llama Guard calls now fail CLOSED (blocked=true, LAYER3_UNAVAILABLE) with explicit console.error logging on a network/API error instead of silently defaulting to permissive safe -- this is backed by real regression tests (defense-in-depth.test.ts) that mock the throw and assert blocking, not just prose. I confirmed via `git log -- src/app/api/help/ask/route.ts` that the original phase_4 commit (cec230a1) never touched this file at all, so the claim that this fix is the first thing to actually wire runDefenseInDepth() into the repo's one real LLM call site is real, not restated. `tsc --noEmit` on the full repo is clean and `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` parses as valid YAML despite its large reindentation diff. No .github/workflows/** files are touched. Two things the human sign-off should verify before merging, neither of which is a defect in this diff's own logic: (1) this codebase's own comments (src/lib/embeddings.ts, src/lib/ingest/extractor.ts) document that GROQ_API_KEY has historically never been set in Vercel production (only in GitHub Secrets) -- if that is still true today, Layer 3 (Llama Guard) and Layer 1's Prompt Guard model call will silently and permanently no-op in production (the code correctly falls back to the documented null-groqApiKey deterministic-only path, so there's no crash or false claim in the code itself, but the real-world security coverage would be materially less than '4-layer' until that env var is actually confirmed live in Vercel); (2) the new fail-closed behavior on the Layer 3 output-side check means any transient Groq network blip after a real (paid) callLLM() completion now discards that completed reply and returns the generic fallback answer -- an intentional security-over-availability tradeoff worth the Owner's explicit sign-off given it's user-facing UX degradation, not just a backend log line.
issues: Verify GROQ_API_KEY is actually configured in Vercel production before relying on this being real 4-layer coverage -- this codebase's own prior comments (lib/embeddings.ts, lib/ingest/extractor.ts) state it historically was never set there, only in GitHub Secrets; if still true, Layer 3 (Llama Guard) and Layer 1's Prompt Guard model check silently no-op in production and only the deterministic Layers 1/2/4 actually run.

Layer 3's new fail-closed behavior discards an already-completed, already-paid-for LLM reply and shows the user a generic fallback answer on any transient Groq network/API error during the output-side guard check, not just on a genuine unsafe-content verdict -- confirm this availability/cost tradeoff is the intended behavior for the Help AI route.

Could not execute `bun test`/`bun run build` in this review environment (no bun binary present); verification here relied on `tsc --noEmit` (clean) plus direct reading of the source and test files rather than an independent full-suite re-run.
